answer: Insider with privileged access proposes a new agent wallet. Mechanism requires stake deposit in an orchard of reputation-tokens earned over time. Each token is a walnut, hard to crack, impossible to forge. Attempt to spawn fake identities triggers a cost spiral—each new clone demands exponentially more staked walnuts. Orchard's fixed token supply caps total possible agents. Constraint: insider cannot manufacture tokens, only earn them through verified task completion.
